# for_Figure6_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly
To set up the embironment, please see another file; for_Figure1.Rmd


## 1. read rnk file
```{r}
GLT_rnk_siCtrl <- read.table("GLT_associated_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly.rnk", header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
```

## 2. obtain gmt file from the web
read library
```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
```

```{r}
gmt <- read.gmt("https://data.broadinstitute.org/gsea-msigdb/msigdb/release/2025.1.Mm/m5.go.bp.v2025.1.Mm.symbols.gmt")
```


## 3. GSEA
```{r}
# make geneList
geneList <- GLT_rnk_siCtrl$V2
names(geneList) <- GLT_rnk_siCtrl$V1

geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

#remove duplicattions
geneList <- geneList[!duplicated(names(geneList))]

#set random seed
set.seed(123)

#do GSEA
Fig6_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly_GSEA <- GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE = gmt, pvalueCutoff = 1)
Fig6_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly_GSEA@result <- Fig6_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly_GSEA@result[
  Fig6_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly_GSEA@result$qvalue < 0.25, 
]
```


check results
```{r}
head(Fig6_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly_GSEA@result)
```

Write the result
```{r, eval=FALSE}
write.csv(Fig6_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly_GSEA@result, file="Fig6_siCtrl_vs_GFPonly.csv")
```
